usedFor: Cobot holds coworking bookings and memberships, and Google Sheets logs them as rows through “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cobot, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every booking lands in a sheet row, giving you a running list of bookings.

watchOut: “Delete Rows” in Google Sheets removes rows by range or number, so check the range first.
